## 2. Professional Biography & Architectural Philosophy
Pratyush Kumar is an independent software engineer and web systems architect. Rather than relying on oversized dependency ecosystems that inflate bundle sizes, introduce software supply-chain vulnerabilities, and increase cold-start latency, Pratyush adheres to a first-principles philosophy:
> "Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability." — Edsger W. Dijkstra

He builds production systems using clean, zero-dependency Node.js core runtimes, high-speed distributed Redis KV caching layers, and fluid 60FPS modern interfaces using React 19, Next.js 15, and GSAP. His software is engineered for low latency (<10ms edge caching), zero cumulative layout shifts (CLS), sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), and statutory compliance with data privacy regulations such as the India Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023).

## 3. Flagship Production Case Studies

### 3.1 Coffee & Cravings (Live Artisan Dining & QR Platform)
- **Live Production URL**: https://www.coffeeandcravings.shop/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/KNOWNASPRATYUSH/Coffee-cravings
- **Role**: Freelance Web Developer & Lead Systems Architect
- **Year Active**: 2026
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - **Zero-Dependency Native Node.js Core**: Written entirely with native Node.js core modules (`http`, `crypto`, `fs`), eliminating third-party framework overhead.
  - **In-Memory Caching & State Management**: Distributed Upstash Redis REST KV storage for sub-10ms global edge latency, active session tracking, and real-time order state machines.
  - **Cryptographic QR Dining**: HMAC-SHA256 cryptographically signed QR tokens across 6 dining tables to eliminate session hijacking and table spoofing.
  - **Real-Time Barista KDS**: Kitchen Display System with instant audio chimes and sub-second order dispatch.
  - **Payments Infrastructure**: Integrated Razorpay webhook consumers with dynamic UPI QR generation and replay-attack mitigations.
  - **Statutory Compliance**: Conforms strictly to the India DPDP Act 2023 with zero third-party tracker leakage.
  - **Automated Test Coverage**: 71/71 tests passed (100% pass rate).

### 3.2 India Fitness (High-Performance Digital Athletics Platform)
- **Live Production URL**: https://india-fitness.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/KNOWNASPRATYUSH/INDIA-FITNESS
- **Role**: Freelance Web Developer
- **Year Active**: 2026
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - **Next.js 15 & React 19 App Router**: Server-side rendered athletic portal for Patna's premier gym destination across Sipara, Kurthaul & Sampatchak.
  - **PostgreSQL Database**: Relational schema handling member tiers, gym facilities, workout catalogs, and training schedules.
  - **GSAP 60FPS Fluid Motion**: Screen transitions, hero animations, and interactive BMI tools operating with locked 60FPS framerate and 0 layout shifts.
  - **Community Scale**: Serving 1,500+ active members and athletes.
